source.title: WAT Leader Announcement (July 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. **William Gan will become the new Leader of the WCA Archive Team (WAT).** 

William was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

William was among three applicants we had and all three candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1B-qKJFfeqn5dPlWUaKyCiK-8nQnHjj_h) if you are interested in viewing them. 

List of the other candidates who applied:
- Raymond Goslow
- Quinn Lawson

translation.title: WCA 档案组负责人任命公告（2022 年 7 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，**William Gan 将担任 WCA 档案组（WAT）的新任负责人。**

依照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 William，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

本次共有三位申请人，包括 William。有兴趣的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1B-qKJFfeqn5dPlWUaKyCiK-8nQnHjj_h)查看三人的申请材料。

其他申请人为：

- Raymond Goslow
- Quinn Lawson
